detail: The PI's line requests $78,000: 30% of a $260,000 base salary. NIH caps salary at $228,000 (Executive Level II, 2026), so at most $68,400 can be charged.
IRB approval for the parent protocol expired 2026-03-31; continuing review is still pending.
PA-25-305 requires data and safety monitoring for the trial; the board is proposed, not constituted.
The feasibility analysis projects 20 participants per site per month; the prior trial enrolled 288 across 4 sites over five years, about 1.2 per site per month.

The prior trial (NCT-FICT-2021-014) reached primary completion 2025-06-30; results were due on ClinicalTrials.gov within 12 months and have not been submitted. PA-25-305 applies the ClinicalTrials.gov reporting terms.
